usage.source_scope: 面向任务的细粒度功能部件与 affordance 标注。
usage.project_application: 作为 L10 功能落点候选：先绑定正确实例，再在实例内部定位门把手、按钮、座位接触面等真正执行功能的区域。
usage.modifications: 保持现有 exact-instance authority 与候选分母；只新增 functional-element 表示，不允许用父对象 bbox 直接充当动作目标。
usage.expected_effect: 在实例身份正确但功能部件错误的故障上，提高 functional-element 命中率并降低 parent-box false handoff。

evaluation.setup: SC8 and SC11 on one SceneFun3D Development scene (visit 420683, video 42445137): ARKit parent binding; SC8 evaluator masks as unlabeled proposals; SC11 truth-blind task-grounded RGB-D proposals sealed before evaluator truth.
evaluation.effect: SC8 proved task-relational selection (4/6 to 6/6 legal, 0.50 to 1.00 recall, 2 to 0 wrong). SC11 then replaced evaluator proposals: multi-view proposal recall reached 10/10 and improved legal tasks 3/6 to 4/6, mean recall 0.50 to 0.8333, and wrong parts 8 to 2 versus single-view.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Positive evidence is limited to one opened SceneFun3D Development scene. SC8 used evaluator proposals; SC11 used privileged parent geometry and posed native RGB-D. Neither establishes phone-camera or open-world coverage, reachability, orientation, arrival, completion, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.
